# CareSide

CareSide is a synthetic hospital-companion prototype. Richard helps a patient review their own recollection, understand source-labeled information, organize unresolved staff questions, and share reviewed updates with an explicitly authorized caregiver.

Live: https://careside.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/billionairebumblebee/careside
Branch: codex/care-side
Canonical context: /llms.txt (repository root copy is canonical; public copy is identical).

## Implemented flow
Talk/type -> editable readback -> patient correction -> explicit confirmation -> reviewed PatientReported timeline.
Known chart collection facts may be answered with source/time. Unknowns enter an exception queue. Authorized patient/caregiver duplicate questions share one item. A synthetic staff answer fans out to authorized viewers. Revocation clears and denies caregiver access.

## Evidence labels
Confirmed: supported simulated chart or explicit staff source, not clinical validation.
PatientReported: patient's reviewed recollection, not upgraded to chart truth.
GeneralEducation: public reference, not a personalized reason for an order.
Unknown: source support is absent or insufficient.
An order does not prove administration; pending does not mean normal; missing discharge clearance remains unknown.

Only a fixed public URL goes to Apify, never patient text. Answer receipts retain actual provider, source ID, retrieval time and Actor link.
Bright Data and Elastic adapters are prepared but live CareSide use is unverified. No direct Anthropic credit redemption, live EHR, Fetch medical service, or Visa hospital integration is claimed.

## API boundaries
POST /api/demo/start creates synthetic case and scoped operator tokens.
GET /api/case returns bearer-owned role-filtered state.
POST /api/intake/draft creates private editable recollection; POST /api/intake/confirm saves an idempotent reviewed PatientReported source.
POST /api/timeline/review records patient review.
POST /api/questions deduplicates unresolved questions for patient or explicitly permitted caregiver.
POST /api/staff-update adds synthetic staff facts, distinguishing orders from administrations.
POST /api/family/authorize, /api/family/share, /api/family/revoke control audience and optional question permission.
POST /api/chat starts an owned, budgeted request; GET /api/chat/:runId resumes the same request without a new provider start.
GET /api/status reports configured provider metadata without secrets.
Convex cases:read enforces current role/token boundaries.

## Safety and limitations
Synthetic case only; no clinical diagnosis, treatment, autonomous urgent response, discharge clearance, external outreach or production clinical identity assurance. Users should contact care staff for urgent changes.
Source quotation/category and bounded contradiction checks are not general semantic entailment or clinical correctness guarantees.
No personal medical records, passwords, API keys or private case links belong in this file or client assets.
Microphone use requires explicit browser permission; typed fallback is available. Companion feeding/coats are presentation only and do not change medical state.
No measured patient outcome or reduced staff workload is claimed. Validation metrics are proposals.
